```{r build-fig-all-sems}
#| fig-asp: 1.618123
#| out-width: "66%"
#| fig-width: 6.6
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# 100% and 10 for slide output

catch_assert <- assertthat::assert_that(
  "ggraph" %in% .packages(),
  msg = "Loading ggraph is required for SEM plots"
) # otherwise outputs TRUE

save_and_output(
  build_fig_all_sems(
    tar_read(
      spatial_sem_output,
      store = store_in_pipeline()
    ),
    sem_type = "nlme",
    label_variables = c(
      sd_r_average_log = "Variability",
      abs_trend_average_log = "Trend",
      HII_focal = "Hum. Imp.",
      mu_SR = "Richness",
      H_fine = "Land. Comp."
    ),
    selected_branch = 1,
    categories = c("farmland", "woodland", "built"),
    font_size = 12
  ),
  filename = here::here("output/fig_all_sems.pdf"),
  bg = "white",
  width = 6.6,
  height = 1.618123 * 6.6,
  units = "in"
)
```
